tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bshad rgyud khri drug stong par gsungs pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor rnam gsum zhes bya ba bzhugs so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba'i ye shes/ 'jam dpal gshin rje nag po gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi snying po/ 'khrul 'khor rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'phrul gyi me long khri drug stong zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las rdo rje 'jigs byed gsungs pa'i skabs las le'u brgyad brgya pa de kho na nyid kyi sbyor ba'i le'u zhes bya bar gsungs pa'i rdzogs rim rnal 'byor rnam gsum zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gti mug bud shing 'od gsal me yis gdod nas bsregs kyang ma he'i zhal can rwa rnon gdengs// zhe sdang me dpung byams pa'i chu yis bcil bar byas kyang mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag gnyis bsnams// 'dod chags rgya mtsho bde chen bskal mes rnam par bskams kyang mtshan ma dmar po srid rtser bsgrengs// dngos po mtshan ma rtsad nas spangs kyang rdzu 'phrul gar mkhan khyod zhabs 'dud// 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa nyams su blang ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs rim gyis rgyud sbyang ba ni kho bo'i bgyis pa'i yang zlog me'i spu gri'i rdzogs rim rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor ram| dbang bzhi'i rnal 'byor du bshad pa ltar nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rnal 'byor snga ma gsum dang phyi ma gsum mo| |dang po rnal 'byor snga ma gsum la/ rgya che ba'i rnal 'byor/ zab pa'i rnal 'byor/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor ro// dang po rgya che ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs tshad med bzhi nas/ dur khrod dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs/ zhes pa'i las byang bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba ltar gsal btab/

de ltar bdag dam tshig sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su ya yig nag po khog stong gi nang du/ ye shes sems dpa' gser mdog pod ral thogs pa dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing rdor skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag la sngags phreng drug ka'am gang rung gis bskor bar dmigs/ sgrub po rlung khrag shas che na hūm̐ de dkar dmar du bsam/ de ltar gsal ba rlung bum pa can drug bzung la de'i ring sems ma yeng bar de rnams la sems gtad la bsgom/ slar de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas bdag lus dam tshig sems dpa'i sku'i nang khengs/ slar hūm̐ de las hūm̐ yig chen po spros la sems gtad/ de la sems brtan par gyur nas hūm̐ rnams las sngags phreng mang po spros la sems bzung*/ de la sems zin nas phyi'i nyi ma dang ya yig sems dang dam tshig sems dpa' rnams la sngar bzhin spros la rim bzhin sems bzung*/ de ltar sems gar gtad du ma yeng bar ma brtan gyi bar du 'bad do// de la brtan nas de rnams las 'od 'phros pas phyi'i 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang du spros la sems bzung*/ de nas nang bcud sems can thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed du spros la sems bzung*/ de ltar sems bzung bas yul snang gang la sems bzung ba/ de las mi 'phro bar nges bar brtan na/ gnyis pa zab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas de rnams rim gyis bsdus la ma he'i zhal du bsdu/ dam tshig sems dpa' nyi ma la bsdu/ nyi ma ya yig la/ ya yig ye shes sems dpa' la/ de hūm̐ la/ de'ang zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo| zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar bsdu la/ nā da shin tu phra ba la sems yun ring du bzung*/ mthar nā da'ang mi dmigs par dmigs med kyi ngang du sems yun ring du bzung ngo*| |gsum pa zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor ni/ slar spro bsdu rgya che ba dang zab pa'i rnal 'byor gong ltar byas mthar/

rgya che ba de nyid ni snang ba rang rgyud du dmigs pa yin la/ zab pa ni stong nyid 'chal pa yin pas na/ 'dir snang stong zung 'jug chu zla lta bur snang sems dbyer med du yun ring bar bsgom/ slar sngar ltar dam tshig pa nyi ma la phog /ye shes sems dpa' sa bon dang bcas pa bsgom/ sngags phreng mi dgos/ de ltar gsal ba'i dam tshig sems dpa'i spyi bor āḥdamar po/ lte bar hūm̐ nag po bsgoms nas srog thur gyi rlung kha sbyor bcing zhing mnan la/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang de'i thig le la sems bzung*/ de'ang dngos med byang chub kyi sems rang rig ye shes gdod ma'i gshis lugs ma yeng bar bsgoms pas tshe 'dir byang chub thob par gsungs so// gnyis pa rnal 'byor phyi ma mtshan ma gyen sgreng zhes pa la'ang gsum te/ kun rdzob kyi rnal 'byor/ don dam gyi rnal 'byor/ dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor ro/ dang po kun rdzob kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba de nyid snang zhing gsal la rang bzhin med par 'ja' tshon lta bur yun ring du ma yeng bar bsgom/ de nas lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi steng du thig le dmar po gcig gsal btab srog rtsol gyi rlung ma he'i sna bug gnyis khengs par rngub/ khong pa'i nang du mar bsdigs la thur ser yar bsdams pas de nyid gyen la log lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim hūm̐ las 'od zer dmar nag 'phros/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad 'od zer dmar nag tu gyur/ de thams cad tshur 'dus lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing rlung bum pa kha sbyar la sems ma yeng bar yun ring du bsgom/ slar snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros brtan g.yo dngos po thams cad rang la thim/ rang lus kyi g.yas zhal gsum ma he'i sna bug g.yas su thim/ g.yon zhal gsum ma he'i sna bug g.yon par thim/ sku dang zhal lhag ma gsum lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ nā da la thim/

nā da stong par gyur pa la sems bzung la yun ring du bsgom mo// gnyis pa don dam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa chu zla lta bur bsgom/ de'ang dngos med skye ba med pa/ stong nyid du sems bcos med bzhag go// gsum pa dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ de ltar kun rdzob don dam gnyis po ma 'gag ngos bzung med pa/ yod med rtag chad kyi mtha' las grol ba/ dngos pos ma reg 'dus ma byas pa/ byang chub kyi sems dngos med stong pa nyid yin pas/ stong nyid la ma zhen ma chags par sems ma yeng bar bsgom mo// des ni chos sku rang grol lo// yang sngags bzlas pas sems bzung ba ni/ las byang gi skabs ltar bdag mdun gsal btab/ rang gi dbugs phar 'gro dus rlung sngags dbyer med 'phros pas mdun bskyed ma he'i zhal du zhugs/ mchod pa phul/ rgyud bskul/ byin rlabs bsdus/ mdun bskyed ma he'i zhal nas rlung sngags dbyer med thon rang gi ma he'i zhal du zhugs byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad bdag la thim par bsam/ srog rtsol yun ring lte 'og tu bcing*/ de'i tshe snying ga'i hūm̐ la sngags gang yang rung ba rim pa gsum du bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ tshur 'dus/ de rnams kyi thugs rnam shes bde ba chen po'i dngos grub bdag la 'dus par bsams pas ni dngos grub chen po thob par gsungs so// gsum pa rjes ni/ las byang ltar bsdu rim gyis lha sku 'od gsal stong pa nyid du bcug /slar de las sgyu ma lta bu'i lha zhal gcig /phyag gnyis par langs te/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya zhing thun mtshams kyi dge ba'i bya ba la 'jug go// smras pa/ bshad rgyud chen po khri dang drug stong par| |gsungs pa'i rdzogs rim rnam gsum mdo tsam 'di// rgyud don de nyid gsal por bkod pa la// gzhan pa'i kha 'gengs bsre lhad med par byas// phyi 'gyur mkhan rnams rtogs bdun rgyud chung gi// rtogs pa bzhi par sgom tshul gsungs pa yis// shin tu mnyam par bzhag bya ba// dpa' bo gnas la gnas pa'o// zhes pa'i gdams ngag tsam la sgro btags nas// dmar nag gzhan gyi rdzogs rim mang bsres pa// rung mthun yin yang dngos su ma bstan pas// 'thad dang mi 'thad btang snyoms lam du btang*// 'di ni tshig don rnam grangs nyung na yang*// rgyud kyi dngos bstan gzhan pa'i lhad med pas// rdzogs byang thob la gcig shos dang mi mnyam// dper na tsha ba'i nad la ga pur ni// rkyang pa ji bzhin nyung yang 'khrul med lam// yin phyir brtson pas bkod kyi snga 'gyur gyi// lam la mos rnams 'bad pas 'di blang rigs// 'di dge 'gro kun don du bdag bsngo'o// zhes bshad rgyud chen po khri drug stong par 'jigs byed gsungs pa de nyid rdzogs rim rgyud don ji lta bar nor 'khrul med pa dmigs rkang du 'brel ba 'di ni/

'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ me khyi nag pa'i dmar po'i rdzogs pa dang po la/ sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog rtse ba gzhis kar sbyar ba'o// //siddhi rastu/ sarba maṅga laṃ//
